queries.description: UNNEST of an aggregate output column of a subquery
queries.sql: SELECT f.series, u.v FROM (SELECT series, ARRAY_AGG(val, 'INT') AS r FROM {tbl} GROUP BY series) f CROSS JOIN UNNEST(f.r) AS u(v) ORDER BY f.series, u.v

queries.description: UNNEST WITH ORDINALITY of an aggregate output column, with a filter on the element
queries.sql: SELECT f.series, u.v FROM (SELECT series, ARRAY_AGG(val, 'INT') AS r FROM {tbl} GROUP BY series) f CROSS JOIN UNNEST(f.r) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(v, o) WHERE u.v > 10 AND u.o >= 1 ORDER BY f.series, u.v
